translations.web: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
translations.bsb: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
translations.kjv: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
translations.asv: In a moment they die, even at midnight; The people are shaken and pass away, And the mighty are taken away without hand.
